subject: Request: Invoice-only vendor onboarding / temporary PO exception for pilot
messages:
From: Maya Collins <maya@cloudstride.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup for CloudStride pilot (invoice vs PO)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. Procurement asked me to confirm our billing flow before we pull together the onboarding paperwork. CloudStride typically sends invoices (Net30) rather than issuing purchase orders. For small, time-boxed pilots we rarely put a PO in place; instead we provide an invoice and any needed contract addendum.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only billing for a $7,500 pilot, or is a PO required to complete vendor setup? If a PO is mandatory, can you advise who we should loop in on your side to expedite?

I can attach our standard onboarding package (W-9, master services terms) if that helps.

Best,
Maya Collins
Head of Partnerships | CloudStride Inc.
maya@cloudstride.com

Looping finance and legal — CloudStride is asking for invoice-only billing for a $7.5k pilot. They can provide W-9 and standard terms.

Questions:
- Is our PO policy absolute for vendor setup, or can we approve an exception for pilots under $10k with manager sign-off?
- If exception allowed, what documentation should we require to protect Redwood (signed temporary exception, procurement onboarding form, invoice routing)?

I've attached the CloudStride onboarding packet they offered and our vendor onboarding form (blank).

Thanks,

priyom_das@redwood.com

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor setup for CloudStride pilot (invoice vs PO)

Thanks for flagging. Short answer: our standard policy prefers PO issuance for any active vendor to ensure coding to the right GL and to anchor liability terms, but we do allow narrowly scoped exceptions for low-dollar pilots when controls are in place.

Proposed exception terms:
- Pilot cap: $10,000 max (CloudStride proposal at $7,500 is OK)
- Exception period: single invoice covering pilot only, dated within 30 days of onboarding
- Required docs before finance sets up vendor: signed W-9, completed Redwood vendor onboarding form, redwood temporary PO-exception form signed by manager
- For legal protection: attach CloudStride's standard terms and add a short addendum referencing Redwood's data/usage constraints for the pilot (I can draft language if needed)
- Payment terms: Net30 to Redwood AP inbox; include invoice reference and CloudStride vendor ID if they have one

If Laura signs off, finance will set up a limited vendor record in the AP system with a flag for "pilot exception" and manual GL coding. We will not allow automatic recurring invoices under this setup.

Let me know and I will prepare the exception form and a short addendum for legal review.

-Dylan Brooks
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor setup for CloudStride pilot (invoice vs PO)

Approved with conditions. I agree with Dylan's control list and add two operational checks:
1) Product owner (Priyom) must confirm pilot acceptance criteria in writing before any payment is processed.
2) Procurement to confirm that the onboarding form fields required for tax and compliance are completed (W-9 verified, address, remittance instructions).

Once those are in place, ok to allow invoice-only vendor setup for this pilot. Please keep the limit at $10k and mark the vendor record with a hard stop for recurring charges.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Vendor setup for CloudStride pilot (invoice vs PO)

Maya — great to move forward. We can accept invoice-only billing for the 6-week pilot under a temporary exception. Next steps:

1) Please complete and return the attached Redwood vendor onboarding form (cloudstride_onboarding_form.pdf) and your W-9 (CloudStride_W9.pdf).
2) Sign the temporary PO-exception acknowledgement (attached: temporary_po_exception_signed.pdf) — this is a short one-page form that captures the pilot cap ($7,500) and confirms CloudStride will submit a single invoice for that amount.
3) We will create a limited vendor record in our AP system flagged "pilot-exception" and process payment Net30 after we receive a single invoice referencing deal DEAL-9421.

Procurement and Finance will hold the vendor record to prevent any recurring charges. Product team (me) will confirm acceptance criteria in writing when the pilot concludes.

Attached for your convenience: cloudstride_onboarding_form.pdf, CloudStride_W9.pdf, temporary_po_exception_signed.pdf

If you can return these by Tuesday, Mar 2, procurement will prioritize setup and we should be able to process the invoice the following week.

Looking forward —
